rules.why: Task has no instruction text. Always a join or sourcing fault rather than a property of the benchmark, and an empty goal silently passes every other rule, so it is checked first and loudly.
Goal embeds a real email address or phone number, so completing it means typing somebody's contact details into a live form.
Goal commits real money. Screened with the shipping SPENDS_MONEY_RE, which is verb-led and narrow enough to use as a gate.
Goal deletes or cancels something. Screened with the shipping DESTROYS_DATA_RE.
The verb the task commands commits to a transaction, a submission, or an account. Checked in commanding position only, so noun uses of the same words do not fire.
Goal signs up for a subscription, trial, or account, phrased as a noun.
Goal targets a signed-in account page, which a login-free run cannot reach.
No start URL. The benchmark records it in the HuggingFace dataset only, and the task text names the site too rarely to infer one honestly.
Start URL is not parseable http(s).
Start URL is an authentication host or path (AUTH_HOST_RE / AUTH_PATH_RE).
Domain requires an account signed in, or is a money-movement or social host.
Start URL returned 4xx/5xx, timed out, or redirected to an auth page.
More than 2 tasks already selected on this domain.
Eligible, but the target of 72 was already filled.

advisories.why: Production DELIVERY_INTENT_RE matched the goal. Advisory only — it is broad by design because in production it permits rather than blocks. Read the goal before promoting.
